latestVersion.changelog:
Pitch Video skill — initial release:

- Instantly turn raw footage or slides into polished investor or sales pitch videos by describing your desired edits; no timeline or export settings required.
- Automated cloud-based rendering delivers 1080p MP4 downloads in 1–2 minutes, with built-in support for text overlays and audio tracks.
- Easy onboarding: uses existing or temporary access tokens, and walks the user through connecting with a friendly status update.
- Clean workflows for uploading, editing, tracking credits, and exporting; all handled seamlessly in one conversational flow.
- Robust support for common video formats (mp4, mov, webm, pptx) up to 500MB.
- Helpful error handling and tips for best results; optimized for under-3-minute pitches.
